description: Source code implementing a GPU memory buffer video frame pool for media processing, including classes for resource management, reference counting, and frame creation.

classes.name: FrameResources
classes.description: Manages GPU memory buffer and shared image resources for a video frame, including initialization and compatibility checks.

classes.name: InternalRefCountedPool
classes.description: Reference-counted pool managing FrameResources, creating video frames, and handling resource lifecycle.

classes.name: RenderableGpuMemoryBufferVideoFramePoolImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the GPU memory buffer video frame pool, utilizing InternalRefCountedPool.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Allocates GPU memory buffer and creates shared images for each plane.

methods.name: IsCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if resources are suitable for given size and color space.

methods.name: CreateVideoFrameAndTakeGpuMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Creates a VideoFrame using the managed GPU memory buffer.

methods.name: ReturnGpuMemoryBufferFromFrame
methods.description: Returns ownership of GPU memory buffer and updates sync tokens.

methods.name: MaybeCreateVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates or reuses FrameResources to produce a VideoFrame.

methods.name: OnVideoFrameDestroyed
methods.description: Callback to handle destruction of VideoFrame, returning resources to the pool.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Prepares the pool for destruction, releasing resources.

methods.name: GetContext
methods.description: Returns the GPU context for resource management.
